    <script type="text/javascript" language="javascript">


        function PrintContent(strid) {

            
           var prtContent = document.getElementById(strid);
           var WinPrint = window.open('', '', 'toolbar=1,scrollbars=1,status=0');
           WinPrint.document.writeln('<HTML><HEAD>')

           WinPrint.document.writeln('<link href="css/DEMO2.CSS" rel="stylesheet" type="text/css"/>');
           //WinPrint.document.writeln('<link href="css/page_elements.css" rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" />');
           //WinPrint.document.writeln('<LINK href=PrintStyle.css ' +
           //           'type="text/css" rel="stylesheet" media="print">');
           WinPrint.document.writeln('</HEAD>');

           WinPrint.document.writeln('<body style = "text-align: center">');
            
           WinPrint.document.write(prtContent.innerHTML);
           WinPrint.document.writeln('</body>');
            
           WinPrint.document.writeln('</HTML>');
           WinPrint.document.close();
           WinPrint.focus();
           WinPrint.print();
           WinPrint.close();
        }
    </script>
